loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The Verifier then evaluates the docstring quality, either approving it or returning it for revision. This process continues until a satisfactory code documentaion is generated or a maximum iteration limit is reached.
loop_primitives.note: Topologically ordered Reader->Searcher->Writer->Verifier pipeline with verify-revise loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Using the DAG, the Navigator performs a topological sort to determine the documentation generation order.
planning_granularity.note: Processing order is a harness schedule, not an agent plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Utilizes a team of specialized agents (`Reader`, `Searcher`, `Writer`, `Verifier`) coordinated by an `Orchestrator`.
multi_agent_topology.note: Could also be read as pipeline.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Verifier can talk to writer if the issue can be address without additional context information

human_in_loop.note: Web UI config form shows no approval setting, but orchestrator code not in bundle.

self_verification.note: Verifier agent reviews Writer output; may share model, arguably self_critique.

retry_policy.note: Fallback default 1 verifier rejection; reader-search attempts default 2.

termination_condition.note: Also verifier approval ends per-component loop (paper Sec. 2.2).

cost_controls.note: rate_limiter.py listed but not in bundle; max_tokens is per-call output limit.

execution_isolation.note: Agents do not execute code per paper (static analysis); no execution config in bundle.
